The Estate One

The One That Feels Right

The Estate One is an upcoming luxury residential address in Sector 63A, Gurugram, where contemporary architecture, thoughtful planning and generous proportions come together in a considered balance of space, design and experience. Spread across 5.08 acres, The Estate One is one of the tallest landmarks in this area.

Set within the established 200 acres Anant Raj Estate, it brings together well-planned residences and a three-level private club, with spaces for wellness, leisure, fitness and relaxation. From a panoramic swimming pool and expansive gymnasium to a spa, cafés, lounges and recreational spaces, each element is designed to bring greater ease and comfort to everyday living.

With expansive balconies, generous open spaces, a distinctive 52-storey presence and a strong emphasis on privacy, The Estate One brings together comfort, design and sophistication in one distinguished address.

Anant Raj Limited
About The Developer

Founded in 1969, Anant Raj Limited is one of India’s most enduring real estate institutions; a lineage that began long before the industry took formal shape. The name itself, drawn from Lala Anant Ram Sarin and Smt. Raj Kumari Sarin, reflects the brand’s core values of respect, resilience, and responsibility.

For over five decades, Anant Raj Limited has moved from stewardship of land to shaping skylines and nurturing communities. Having delivered landmark residential, commercial, and IT infrastructure projects, the company today stands at the forefront of India’s digital transformation with its pioneering data centre developments.
